items.title_zh: 葬礼变成婚礼，男子在UP's Maharajganj与情人的尸体结婚
items.title_en: Funeral Turns Into Wedding As Man Marries Lover's Dead Body In UP's Maharajganj
items.summary_zh: 这起离奇事件发生在尼赫劳尔地区，一名当地年轻人因未婚夫的去世而悲痛欲绝，坚持在她的最后仪式前为他们举行婚礼
items.summary_en: The bizarre incident unfolded in the Nichlaul area, where a local youth, devastated by the death of his fiance, insisted on solemnising their marriage before her last rites

items.title_zh: 汗先生对妻子的“Ghoonghat”争议做出反应：“这是她的决定”
items.title_en: Khan Sir Reacts To Wife’s ‘Ghoonghat’ Controversy: ‘It Was Her Decision’
items.summary_zh: 在整个招待会过程中，汗爵士的妻子一直用红色面纱遮住脸，引发了一波批评。
items.summary_en: Throughout the reception, Khan Sir's wife kept her face covered with a red veil, sparking a wave of criticism.

items.title_zh: 什么是咖啡狂欢？班加罗尔、孟买追赶潮流的最新趋势
items.title_en: What Is Coffee Rave? All About Latest Trend As Bengaluru, Mumbai Catch Up With Craze
items.summary_zh: 咖啡狂欢是席卷孟买和德里等印度城市的最新趋势，提供有 DJ 表演和浓缩咖啡的无酒精早间派对。
items.summary_en: Coffee raves are the latest trend sweeping Indian cities like Mumbai and Delhi, offering alcohol-free morning parties with DJs and espresso shots.
